text.description_html:
Acorn RPJBP Bean Tip Rough Iron Pull

This 6-3/4" pull made by Acorn is perfect to use on lightweight doors, garden gates, or as decorative pieces. The Bean Tip Rough Iron Garden Gate Door Pull is lightweight and easy to install with just a few screws.

The beautiful rough black iron finish has a lifetime no rust warranty. The weathered appearance of cast iron duplicates that found on the ironwork of many old European castles and cathedrals.

Specifications of the Bean Tip Door Pull

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Height: 6-3/4"
  • Width: 2-1/8"
  • Projection: 1-5/8"
  • Lifetime No-Rust Finish Warranty!

Sold individually. Package includes 1 pull and hardware for a surface mounted application.
